description: This Java class, OpenmrsProfileExcludeFilter, implements the TypeFilter interface to control bean creation based on OpenMRS platform version and module states. It filters beans during Spring component scanning based on OpenMRS profile attributes, version compatibility, and module status.

classes.name: OpenmrsProfileExcludeFilter
classes.description: A Spring TypeFilter implementation that includes or excludes beans based on OpenMRS profile attributes, platform version, and module status.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Determines if a class should be excluded based on OpenMRS profile attributes, platform version, and module states. Implements the Spring TypeFilter interface.

methods.name: matchOpenmrsProfileAttributes
methods.description: Evaluates the openmrsProfile map to determine if the current environment matches the specified OpenMRS profile constraints.
